messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync — customer Vega wants tenant-level routing isolation plus 50ms p95 cross-region. They're asking for launch criteria we can sign against. Need product + ops scope by EOW.
eli (eng-arch): Noted. Do we assume dedicated GPU pools per tenant or soft isolation lanes? Cost vs cold-start tradeoffs.
jonathan (sre): For 50ms p95 cross-region we need edge routing + regional warm pools. Also perf SLO verification harness.
sara (product): Sales says Vega will pay for isolation if we can promise 99.95% and clear fallback semantics. @kevin can confirm?
kevin (sales): Confirmed — Vega is ok with a 12mo commit if we can deliver per-tenant affinity and documented fallback behavior.
maria (PM): Proposed launch gates (MVP -> GA): 1) Routing primitives (affinity, fallback, capacity tiers) 2) Bench SLOs met (p95 latency + failover) 3) Ops playbook + per-tenant observability.
eli (eng-arch): Add gating: model-variant fallback semantics (quantized vs full) must be deterministic and auditable.
jonathan (sre): Also require chaos tests for region failover: automated failover < 30s and no request loss. I'll add to the test plan.
infra-bot: deploy: canary routing-v2 started on cluster us-east-1
sara (product): Scope question: do we include KV-prefix caching isolation in MVP or only request routing? Vega specifically worried about cache leakage.
eli (eng-arch): Recommend KV namespacing per tenant and memquota enforcement. Minimal sample config below: 
```
routing:
  tenant_affinity: true
  cache_namespace: tenant_id
  fallback: regional->global
```
maria (PM): Risks: cost delta if many tenants choose dedicated lanes; migration complexity for current tenants; billing attribution ambiguity.
jonathan (sre): Ops checklist: migration window, rollback plan, per-tenant dashboards, alert thresholds. I'll draft pager thresholds and dashboards.
kevin (sales): Prioritization: Vega deal is time-sensitive. Suggest routing primitives + bench SLOs = high priority; console/UI can be wave 2.
eli (eng-arch): Rough delivery estimate: primitives = 3 sprints, bench infra = 2 sprints, console = 3 sprints. ~8 sprints if some work runs in parallel.
sara (product): Can we define an MVP that supports N tenants on dedicated pools + soft isolation for shared tenants? Need clear acceptance criteria.
maria (PM): MVP acceptance (short): - tenant-level routing toggle - bench p95 <= 70ms intra-region and <= 120ms cross-region under N-load - documented deterministic fallback - ops runbook + canary process.
jonathan (sre): Add prerequisite: automated canary + rollback for routing config changes.
eli (eng-arch): Open questions: quota enforcement (soft vs hard), billing attribution per-tenant, SLA composition math for mixed dedicated/shared workloads.
maria (PM): Action items: Eli draft API/config spec by Tue; Jonathan draft ops test suite by Wed; Sara coordinate customer expectations with Kevin. Reconvene Thu 10am.
kevin (sales): I'll update Vega with MVP scope and get written sign-off.
maria (PM): thanks all :thumbsup:
